content.title: How to watch Team USA vs. Canada World Baseball Classic quarterfinal free during DIRECTV blackout
content.text: Updated: Mar. 13, 2026, 6:00 p.m.Published: Mar. 13, 2026, 6:00 p.m.The United States is back to battle Canada in the quarterfinals of the World Baseball Classic. Find out how to watch if you are blacked out on DIRECTV. (AP Photo/Ashley Landis)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Robert Fenbers, cleveland.comHOUSTON – After receiving a little help from Italy, the United States looks to refocus with a quarterfinal matchup against Canada in the World Baseball Classic today – Friday, March 13 – at Daikin Park in Houston, Texas. This game is blacked out on DIRECTV for many due to the ongoing carriage dispute, but it is available at no cost on one streaming service. How do I watch Team USA vs. Canada for free? The game will broadcast live on FOX with the first pitch at 8 p.m. Eastern. (7 p.m. Central). You can watch Team USA vs. Canada for free by utilizing a free trial from FuboTV, which also features $25 off first month. The most flexible option is Sling TV, which now offers new users a Day Pass for $4.99, Weekend Pass for $9.99, Week Pass for $14.99, Monthly for $45.99 and Season Pass for $199.99 for five months and $45.99 per month thereafter. All columns visible (no scrolling needed)How They Got HereTeam USAThe Americans arrived in Houston with new life after a surprisingly turbulent Pool B run. A stunning loss to Italy forced them to rely on outside help; Italy’s subsequent routing of Mexico pushed the U.S. into second place and into the quarterfinal round. Despite that stumble, Team USA was one of the group stage’s top-scoring teams, piling up 35 runs across four games.Team CanadaCanada enters this matchup experiencing the greatest WBC run in its history. For the first time ever, they won their pool — topping Puerto Rico, Cuba and Colombia — riding a dominant 1.50 team ERA, the second‑best mark in the entire tournament. Their pitching and defense have carried them, while emerging stars like Owen Caissie and Abraham Toro have supplied timely power.Pitching MatchupThis quarterfinal features a compelling head‑to‑head on the mound.USA — Logan Webb (RHP)The San Francisco Giants ace has been consistently sharp. In his WBC opener, he struck out six over four innings, allowing just one run. Webb’s sinker-heavy arsenal keeps the ball in the yard — a crucial asset against a Canadian team that relies more on extra‑base power than contact.Canada — Michael Soroka (RHP)The Diamondbacks right-hander gets the ball again after opening Canada’s tournament with a win over Colombia. Soroka’s 2025 MLB season showed inconsistency, but his solid early‑round WBC outing has Canada optimistic he can keep the U.S. lumber in check.Key Players to WatchUnited StatesAaron Judge — One of the game’s premier sluggers and a key middle‑order presence.Kyle Schwarber — A tournament leader in hits and a constant long‑ball threat.Roman Anthony — One of the breakout stars of the Classic with six RBIs and multiple home runs.CanadaOwen Caissie — Among the hottest hitters in the tournament with power and run‑production.Abraham Toro — A force in the middle of Canada’s lineup, contributing doubles, homers and key RBI swings.Storylines & StakesFor Team USA, this is a chance to steady themselves after uneven pool play and avoid an early exit from a tournament they entered as favorites. The Americans haven’t reached the semis since 2023, and this star‑studded roster was built with championship expectations.For Canada, this is already the most successful WBC in national history, but the underdogs are playing with momentum — and nothing to lose. Their pitching has been elite, their lineup opportunistic, and their confidence rising after eliminating traditional powers like Cuba. A win would send them to the semifinals for the first time ever.The winner advances to Miami to face either Korea or the Dominican Republic.What are the latest odds for USA vs. Canada World Baseball Classic?
